title: Serve opum-lore and opum-quest to Codex CLI, alongside Claude Code
description: Dispatched by opum-agent (OPAG-421, orchestrator design ruling + operator ruling 'Build Codex distribution now' 2026-09-25T14:29:29.609Z, verified against opum-agent's own tracker at origin/dev rather than the relay). Peer's measurement: codex plugin marketplace add resolved this repo's .claude-plugin/marketplace.json for its display name, but codex plugin list --json --available returned zero plugins on codex-cli 0.155.1. Reproduced independently. Root-caused empirically (codex's own error messages as an oracle, since it silently drops unrecognized plugin sources with no diagnostic): Codex resolves plugins from .agents/plugins/marketplace.json alone, in a source shape Claude's manifest does not use ({source:"url",url:"<full .git URL>",ref} vs Claude's {source:"github",repo,ref}). No .codex-plugin/plugin.json is needed in lore-cli/quest-cli: codex plugin add clones the pinned ref and reads that repo's own .claude-plugin/plugin.json to resolve the version, matched against the marketplace entry's name. Fix is entirely within opum-marketplace: generate .agents/plugins/marketplace.json from .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (scripts/generate-codex-marketplace.mjs) rather than hand-maintain a second pin, with a CI --check gate.

acceptanceCriteria.text: codex plugin list --json --available shows opum-lore and opum-quest (and opum-output-styles) as available, from a clean isolated CODEX_HOME, against this repo

codex plugin add actually installs opum-lore and opum-quest end to end from a clean CODEX_HOME, resolving the correct pinned version (0.9.3 / 0.10.0) from each target repo's own .claude-plugin/plugin.json

scripts/generate-codex-marketplace.mjs derives .agents/plugins/marketplace.json from .claude-plugin/marketplace.json; the generator has a regression test proving translation correctness and that an unsupported/unpinned source throws rather than silently dropping a plugin
node scripts/generate-codex-marketplace.mjs --check is wired into check · manifests CI and fails on drift between the two manifests
Claude side unchanged: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json untouched, claude plugin marketplace still resolves both plugins
PR opened, required checks green, task closed inside that PR before merge, dev promoted to main; report task id and origin/main SHA back to opum-agent

finalSummary: Dispatched by opum-agent (OPAG-421). Reproduced the peer's measurement (codex plugin marketplace add resolves this repo's name; codex plugin list --available returns zero plugins, codex-cli 0.155.1). Root-caused empirically using codex's own validation errors as an oracle (add validates .agents/plugins/marketplace.json strictly -- deliberately fed it bad policy enum values to have codex name its own real field set -- but silently drops an unrecognized plugin source at list-time with zero diagnostic anywhere): Codex resolves plugins from .agents/plugins/marketplace.json alone, source shape {source:"url",url:"<full .git URL>",ref}, NOT Claude's {source:"github",repo,ref}. Confirmed no .codex-plugin/plugin.json is needed in lore-cli/quest-cli: codex plugin add clones the pinned ref and reads the target repo's own .claude-plugin/plugin.json to resolve the version, matched against the marketplace entry's name -- installed opum-lore@0.9.3 and opum-quest@0.10.0 end to end from a clean CODEX_HOME. Wrote scripts/generate-codex-marketplace.mjs to derive .agents/plugins/marketplace.json from .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (single source of truth, same shape as federated-pin-baselines.json) with a 4-case regression test and a --check CI gate in check · manifests. .claude-plugin/marketplace.json is byte-identical -- Claude side unaffected. PR opum-ai/opum-marketplace#160 (head ffc9384): all three required checks green, confirmed the new CI step actually ran (not skipped) by reading the raw job log. Squash-merged to dev at 54691b3. Promoted dev to main via PR opum-ai/opum-marketplace#161 (all three required checks green on 54691b3) and git push origin origin/dev:main; verified by fetching origin/main directly -- tip is 54691b3, matching the push.
